'''Melindra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] operative of the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] she was stationed on [[Voss]], where she asked an Imperial to destroy several listening posts.
